text: 😮 An Experimental 'Green Threads' Implementation for Node James has opened a PR that adds a new, lightweight kind of worker that shares a small pool of OS threads, with each worker getting its own V8 isolate (but no Node APIs). His numbers show a thousand of them using about 1GB of memory vs 6.7GB for regular worker threads. Early days, but a promising idea that deserves feedback. James M Snell
